title: Aïn Sebaâ Station
summary: Competition entry for a new two-headed train station in the Aïn Sebaâ industrial zone of Casablanca, linked by an urban footbridge.
tag: Competition entry / Concours n°S053/PLGV / Phase II

narrative.text: The project provides for the demolition of the existing station and the construction of a new two-headed rail infrastructure, organised around a main hub located on the major axis and a secondary hub positioned on the secondary axis.
narrative.source: pdf2025:p40 (translated from French; the sentence that follows is cut off in the PDF)

narrative.text: An urban footbridge will be integrated to ensure a fluid and safe connection between the two sides of the railway tracks, facilitating the movement of pedestrians and cyclists while improving intermodality with other means of transport. The platforms include underground accesses to guarantee fluid circulation and the safety of users.

The architecture of the project rests on a roof with clean lines, designed to provide optimal protection while offering a recognisable visual identity. The use of materials adapted to technical and climatic requirements guarantees the durability and efficiency of the structure.
